replacements.instruction: Align the Appendix process/resource table with the study's three generation runs rather than silently presenting the first run. Report the mean of the three run-level summaries for every resource/process field, and remove the run-1-only completion column because its existing macro is not a three-run summary.

Replace the run-1-only output-length-ratio table with the already available length-matched win rates from all three generation runs. Keep repeated generations separate rather than aggregating them as independent observations.
Make the process/resource Appendix prose match the three-run table, using generated three-run mean macros rather than first-run values.
replacements.before:
Table~\ref{tab:process-summary} reports completion, output size, delegated invocations, goal events, token accounting, and wall-clock time from the first generation run.
For \condAgenticCogWriter, that run uses \AfourOutputTokens\ output-plus-reasoning tokens and \AfourInputTokens\ uncached input tokens per attempted run and records \AfourGoalRegenerated\ accepted goal regeneration.
Across the three generation runs, the trace summaries contain mean totals of \AfourGoalCreatedMean\ goal-creation events and \AfourGoalDevelopedMean\ goal-development events, while the post-\texttt{Reviewing} ledger contains \AfourLedgerEntriesMean\ entries including \AfourLedgerWithProposalMean\ explicit regeneration proposals.
replacements.after:
Table~\ref{tab:process-summary} reports three-run mean output size, delegated invocations, goal events, token accounting, and wall-clock time.
For \condAgenticCogWriter, the three-run means are \AfourOutputTokensMean\ output-plus-reasoning tokens and \AfourInputTokensMean\ uncached input tokens per attempted run, with \AfourGoalRegeneratedMean\ accepted goal-regeneration events.
The trace summaries likewise contain mean totals of \AfourGoalCreatedMean\ goal-creation events and \AfourGoalDevelopedMean\ goal-development events, while the post-\texttt{Reviewing} ledger contains \AfourLedgerEntriesMean\ entries including \AfourLedgerWithProposalMean\ explicit regeneration proposals.

replacements.instruction: Make the output-length sensitivity Appendix report all three generation runs. Remove the run-1-only W/L/T and descriptive p-value prose and explain that run-level rates stay separate because the same prompts are regenerated across runs.
replacements.before:
Table~\ref{tab:appendix-length-control} reports pairwise outcomes by output-length ratio.
The longer side wins \LengthLongerRate\ of \LengthLongerNonTie\ non-tied comparisons.
In the tighter pre-specified matching band, the outcomes from the first generation run for our system are \LengthFullSinglePassFiveWLT\ versus \condSinglePass\ ($p=\LengthFullSinglePassFiveP$), \LengthFullTaskPlanningFiveWLT\ versus \condTaskPlanning\ ($p=\LengthFullTaskPlanningFiveP$), and \LengthFullNoGoalsFiveWLT\ versus \condNoGoals.
In the wider pre-specified band, the corresponding outcomes are \LengthFullSinglePassTenWLT\ ($p=\LengthFullSinglePassTenP$), \LengthFullTaskPlanningTenWLT\ ($p=\LengthFullTaskPlanningTenP$), and \LengthFullNoGoalsTenWLT\ ($p=\LengthFullNoGoalsTenP$).
These matching-band $p$-values are unadjusted descriptive sign-test results.
replacements.after:
Table~\ref{tab:appendix-length-control} reports length-matched pairwise win rates for each of the three generation runs.
For each run, it shows our system against \condSinglePass, \condTaskPlanning, and \condNoGoals within the tighter and wider pre-specified output-length matching bands, using $W/(W+L)$ after the two-order consistency rule and excluding ties.
Keeping the three run-level rates separate avoids treating repeated generations of the same prompts as independent observations while showing whether the sensitivity direction is stable across runs.
